overview: This Senate resolution honors the life of Brian Wilson, the co-founder and main songwriter of the Beach Boys, who died on June 11, 2025. It recounts his rise as a self-taught musical prodigy in California, the band's string of hits in the 1960s, his landmark album Pet Sounds and his long-delayed album Smile, completed in 2004. It also notes his honors, including the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame and Kennedy Center Honors, and his openness about mental health and addiction struggles. The Senate agreed to it by unanimous consent on October 6, 2025.
for: Supporters say the resolution recognizes one of the most influential American songwriters and his openness about mental health, which helped reduce stigma.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or spending.
